notes.title: The final update of the game.
notes.content:
[b]Hello, guys!
A native English speaker has completely finished proofreading the script. 
Fixed typos, errors, and inaccuracies.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38586722/8af35260c92c3b330b448a3a7af2c4dcb0111e7d.png[/img]
Enjoy the game!

[b]If you notice a typo or error, please contact us. [/b][url=https://twitter.com/LotosProject]Twitter[/url] 
lotosprojectgame@gmail.com

[b]We'll fix it immediately. 
Thanks.[/b]
